unitTranslations.FGU_000001: If you get into the habit of checking the process leading to the conclusion step by step, mistakes will be reduced.
unitTranslations.FGU_000002:
Students have an excellent ability to quickly understand and structure the overall situation in a project or assignment.
“My strength is the initiative to make and execute plans on my own, and I have recently also developed the habit of carefully checking procedures.”
unitTranslations.FGU_000003:
"Students are not biased toward a specific method, but have an excellent ability to flexibly utilize various methods, such as planning, immersing themselves, looking at the whole, or keeping order, depending on the situation.
My strength is the ability to adapt to change my approach according to the nature of the task, and I have recently been developing the habit of finding the method that suits me on my own.”
unitTranslations.FGU_000004: The power to envision a structure in which several things fit together at once.
unitTranslations.FGU_000005: Even if you select “Computer Engineering”, simultaneous processing is possible.
unitTranslations.FGU_000006:

The suitability is not determined by “department” but by the combination of “department × my profile”.
unitTranslations.FGU_000007: Anyone can feel broken if they don't see the results of their efforts.
unitTranslations.FGU_000008: This is the expression that best reveals your strength in planning.
unitTranslations.FGU_000009: The ability to process information in a certain order.
unitTranslations.FGU_000010: Ability to process and remember information in order
unitTranslations.FGU_000011:
Planning is closely related to the prefrontal cortex.
This area is responsible for goal setting, self-regulation, and time management, and the more you repeat the experience of actually making and executing a plan, the stronger it becomes.
Sequential processing is closely related to working memory, which remembers verbal and auditory information in order, and this function is known to develop steadily through learning and training until the mid-20s.
In other words, the current low sequential processing score is not a fixed limit, but an area that can be sufficiently improved through short and repetitive procedural training.
unitTranslations.FGU_000012: We recommend that you check the changes in the area together.
unitTranslations.FGU_000013: When dealing with multiple methods at the same time becomes overwhelming
unitTranslations.FGU_000014: If you get into the habit of going over the steps leading to the conclusion one by one, you will make fewer mistakes.
unitTranslations.FGU_000016:
“When starting a project or assignment, the student excels at planning the entire schedule in advance and executing it step by step.
“My strength is the initiative to readjust my plans on my own even when things go awry, and I’ve recently also developed the habit of carefully recording the execution process.”
